title: Spring assembly moved to Friday
body: Hold period 7 for an all-school assembly in the gym. Buses run on the late bell.

title: Course-selection window opens Monday
body: Counsellors will preview next-year electives during advisory. Submit your top three by May 16.

title: Family plan renews May 14
body: You’ll be charged $9.99/mo. Update payment in Settings → Billing if needed.
